objective: Test local feasibility and joint correctness of relational Constraint-SFT; no server, DPO or GRPO claims
training_precision: BF16 base, FP32 LoRA and loss; fixed paired minibatches; no TF32
evaluation_precision: FP32, TF32 disabled; resolves observed BF16 batch/single numerical differences
supervision: Joint NLI/MCQA adapter. 102 exposed source labels per task from 1024 (9.9609%). Identical gold IDs across arms. Hidden labels and ASTs absent from train_public.json. Trainer never opens oracle.json or evaluation data.json.
batch_structure: 2 labelled NLI originals+2 swaps; 2 labelled MCQA originals+2 transported exact-label views; 2 unlabelled MCQA originals+2 permutation views; 2 unlabelled NLI originals+2 swaps
unlabelled_nli: Bernoulli-JS of contradiction marginals under swap; no gold-conditioned allowed sets
unlabelled_mcqa: Standard permutation-equivariant JS in semantic-option coordinates; known-method positive control, not novelty
sft_compute: Replace all 16 views with original labelled prompts of the same task and closest token length; full-vocabulary CE on every view. Same steps and sequence count, nonpadding token budget within 1%; report actual counts.
zero_weight_control: Other arms compute identical forward/loss graphs, but unused components have zero coefficient; their wasted-compute baseline is separately distinguished from sft_compute
loss_scale: Anchor mean CE, plus .3*.5*(NLI exact-C reverse+MCQA exact augmented CE), .3*.5*NLI non-singleton allowed mass, .3*MCQA JS, .3*NLI Bernoulli JS when enabled
hyperparameters: Weights and steps preselected without any dev/test model scores; no search or mid-run tuning
checkpoint: Final optimizer step 256 only. All 15 final adapter hashes frozen before any dev/test/OOD evaluation
evaluation: All variants; primary conditional label-token probabilities; separately report raw full-vocabulary next-token invalid rate and accuracy. No free-form or long-response claims
primary_endpoint: All-transform-correct (ATC) on 2048 OOD bundles per task, plus task-balanced mean; each bundle is one resampling unit
ood_scope: Increased complexity AND changed surface wording together; synthetic local pilot, not real-world/OOD benchmark validation
ci_scope: Paired bundle bootstrap conditional on three fixed trained seed pairs; not full training-seed uncertainty. No multiplicity-adjusted universal claims
pass_rule: For each task separately vs sft_compute AND exact_aug: OOD ATC 95% lower CI > 0; accuracy difference lower CI > -0.01; RVR difference upper CI < 0. All integrity gates must pass. Report contribution vs consistency separately; do not call it new if indistinguishable.
failure_rule: RVR improvement alone is failure; uncertain CI is inconclusive. Test/OOD outcomes cannot trigger edits or reruns of this frozen experiment. Further development requires new protocol and fresh holdout.
